Rebirth

202632 photographs
About the project

Rebirth is about the feeling a mother goes through after giving birth: the postpartum period as a kind of becoming. I creative directed, photographed, and edited the concept, with a companion film that tells more of the story.

It was a collaboration with model Roxy Pryor, hair and makeup artist Max Rintoul, and stylist Ebony Brown, who made a custom dress for the concept.
